text:
maria: Heads up — noticed steady memory growth from the KV cache in the long-context regression suite. RSS climbs ~1.6GB every hour when reuse rate is low. Repro attached below.

perf-bot: nightly-run: kv-long-context · PASS with warning (rss-growth=1.5GB/hr) · profile=/artifacts/kv_long_1742508000.prof :warning:

jia: Can you paste the exact bench command so I can repro locally?

maria: Sure — running this locally:
```
./kv_bench --workload long_context --seq-len 65000 --reuse-rate 0.2 --duration 60m --profile /tmp/kv_long.prof --metrics-port 6060
```
Also started with --kv-eviction=lru and default page-size (4MB).

ryan: I ran a quick pass. Confirmed rising fragmentation counter: jemalloc stats show retained grows slower than active but fragmentation_bytes steadily increases. Sample from /debug/heap: active=22.3GB mapped=27.1GB retained=2.0GB fragmentation=1.9GB

dan: Interesting. Could be paging churn causing allocation patterns that defeat coalescing. Do we have traces of eviction decisions?

maria: Yes — added a tracing span around eviction. Observed frequent evict/restore cycles for same keys when prefix segments are mis-aligned across requests. Sequence: evict page A -> allocate new small slab -> reuse fails -> load A back soon after.

jia: That matches a fragmentation hypothesis: variable-length attention prefixes create uneven page fills. We should test two axes: 1) prefix alignment (constant vs variable segment lengths) 2) reuse distribution (hot-key skew vs uniform).

maria: Proposal for regression test suite: a synthetic generator that can emit workloads for N hours with knobs:
- seedable segment length distribution (uniform, power-law)
- reuse probability
- page size variation (4MB, 8MB)
- eviction policy toggle (lru, clock, size-aware)
Then assert: RSS_growth_per_hour < 0.5GB and kv_fragmentation_bytes < 512MB after warmup.

dan: +1. Also add counters to /metrics: kv_evictions_total, kv_eviction_reinserts_total, kv_fragmentation_bytes, kv_reuse_hits_total. CI can fail if eviction_reinserts_total/kv_evictions_total > 0.25 for long-context test.

ryan: I can sketch the harness. I'll add a reproducible synthetic workload using the existing bench infra and make it a nightly regression. We should also capture a small flamegraph. Example run command for CI:
```
./kv_bench --workload synth_long --seed 42 --duration 2h --seq-len 65000 --reuse-rate 0.2 --profile /artifacts/ci_kv_$(date +%s).prof
```

maria: From the profiling sample, top hot paths are:
- kv_page_alloc (37%)
- memcpy (18%)
- eviction_scan (12%)
- lock contention on kv_bucket (6%)
So allocation + memcpy + eviction churn are dominant.

jia: Could we change page allocator to favor slab coalescing for long contexts? Or add a small per-request arena for tiny reallocs to avoid fragmenting big pages. Worth trying a patch and running the regression.
